## What's New in v0.4.0

### Onboarding — A Cinematic Welcome for New Users

First-time users are now greeted with a full-screen, 6-slide onboarding experience that introduces what Loadout does and the AI tools it supports. The flow walks through MCP servers, skills & rules, hooks & agents, and wraps up with a call to action — all with smooth animations and an orbit visualization of the 10 supported tools. It only shows once (persisted in localStorage), but you can replay it anytime from **Settings → See Onboarding Again**.
